subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw expose these three transcript write-lock fact queries as a supported public Plugin SDK contract for the Codex and Copilot mirrors?
rationale: The methods are a new compatibility-sensitive SDK surface; choosing whether this is the durable plugin contract cannot be resolved from correctness tests alone.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Approve the three fact-only methods after rebasing and require current-head proof that both mirrors preserve dedupe and sequencing behavior.

options.title: Use a narrower owner seam
options.body: Decline the public SDK expansion and redesign the shared runtime boundary so the mirror-specific optimization does not become a general plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve the three fact-only methods after rebasing and require current-head proof that both mirrors preserve dedupe and sequencing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged transcript foundation and the proposed mirror follow-up, so they are best positioned to explain the intended contract and incorporate owner direction.
